outcome: Factors influencing preparation for labor after cesarean section
cohort: 288 pregnant women who had a previous cesarean section
finding: Women's birth preferences changed after labor, with a large proportion of those who had a vaginal birth after cesarean section preferring this mode of delivery in their next pregnancy.
mod_finding: Among women who preferred a vaginal birth, nearly 80% attempted it and 49.78% delivered vaginally; among those preferring an elective cesarean, 30% attempted a vaginal birth.
